endorsements.quote: Lastly, the fifth consideration is critical analysis and monitoring of AI/ML models to identify and address potential unintended consequences.
This necessitates a focus on the quality of the data and agreed-upon standards such as Health Level 7 Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (HL7 FHIR).13

unlisted_practices: Automate primary care data collection through interoperable EHRs and health devices.
Organize fragmented primary care data using agreed-upon interoperability standards to enable access for researchers and industry.
Use federated learning and APIs to enable AI/ML collaboration without sharing raw patient data.
Identify primary care-specific AI/ML use cases focused on care delivery, quality, and population-level health.
Integrate AI/ML tools into human workflows using quality improvement and implementation science frameworks.
Increase collaboration between the AI/ML research community and primary care.
Increase public and private funding for AI/ML research, development, and implementation in primary care.
Upgrade human and data infrastructure to support AI/ML in primary care.
Federal agencies should establish AI governance policies, streamlined approval processes, and enhanced public funding that address primary care.

screen.reason: This is a perspective/framework paper proposing high-level considerations and recommendations around data transformation, workflow integration, and surveillance for AI implementation in primary care.
